Reference

API reference

AI search as a service. Search keys are browser-safe; admin keys are not. Version 0.1.0. Generated from the OpenAPI spec (packages/sdk/openapi.json).

Basics

  • Base URL: __API_URL__ (hosted beta), or your own server.
  • Auth: Authorization: Bearer <key> or X-Findaro-Key: <key>.
  • Keys: the admin key manages data and is refused from browsers; the search key can only call search and chat, and browser requests are accepted only from the project's allowed_origins.
  • Errors: {"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": ...}}. Invalid requests are 422 with code invalid_request; 401 means a missing or wrong key; 429 means the per-key rate limit was hit.
  • Caching: search results are cached for 60 s per data version; send Cache-Control: no-cache to bypass.
  • Schema roles: id, title, description, text, facet, keyword, numeric, price, currency, category, boolean, image_url, url, ignore.

Endpoints: Projects · Documents and import · Jobs · Schema · Search · Chat · Schemas

Projects

POST /v1/projects

Create Project

Auth: Bootstrap token, if the server sets FINDARO_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN (self-hosted). On the hosted beta we create projects for you.

Request body

application/json: CreateProject | null

Responses

  • 201 {"project_id", "admin_key", "search_key", "name"}. The keys are shown only once.
  • 422 Invalid request (error code invalid_request, with details).

GET /v1/projects/{project_id}

Get Project

Auth: Admin key (server-side only; refused from browsers).

Parameters

NameInType
project_idpathstringrequired

Responses

  • 200 project_id, name, created_at, document_count, has_schema, schema_version, reindex_pending, allowed_origins.
  • 422 Invalid request (error code invalid_request, with details).

DELETE /v1/projects/{project_id}

Delete Project

Auth: Admin key (server-side only; refused from browsers).

Parameters

NameInType
project_idpathstringrequired

Responses

  • 204 204 No Content. Deletes the project, its index and keys.
  • 422 Invalid request (error code invalid_request, with details).

PUT /v1/projects/{project_id}/settings

Put Settings

Project settings. allowed_origins: browser origins that may use the search key (exact like "https://shop.example.com", or "https://*.example.com"; localhost always works in dev).

Auth: Admin key (server-side only; refused from browsers).

Parameters

NameInType
project_idpathstringrequired

Request body

application/json: ProjectSettings

Responses

  • 200 {"allowed_origins": [...]}. Origins look like https://shop.example.com or https://*.example.com.
  • 422 Invalid request (error code invalid_request, with details).

Documents and import

POST /v1/projects/{project_id}/documents

Upsert Documents

Auth: Admin key (server-side only; refused from browsers).

Parameters

NameInType
project_idpathstringrequired

Request body

A JSON array of documents, or {"documents": [...]}. Up to 10,000 per request. Documents are upserted by their id field.

Responses

  • 202 202 with {"job_id", "status": "queued", "status_url"}.
  • 422 Invalid request (error code invalid_request, with details).

POST /v1/projects/{project_id}/import

Import File

Auth: Admin key (server-side only; refused from browsers).

Parameters

NameInType

formatquerystring | nulloptional

Request body

Multipart form with file: .csv, .jsonl or .json, up to 50 MB. format overrides detection from the file name.

Responses

  • 202 202 with {"job_id", "status": "queued", "status_url"}.
  • 422 Invalid request (error code invalid_request, with details).

Schema

GET /v1/projects/{project_id}/schema

Get Schema

Auth: Admin key (server-side only; refused from browsers).

Parameters

NameInType
project_idpathstringrequired

Responses

  • 200 {"schema": {"fields": [{"name", "role", ...}]}, ...}: the inferred or overridden field roles.
  • 422 Invalid request (error code invalid_request, with details).

PUT /v1/projects/{project_id}/schema

Put Schema

Auth: Admin key (server-side only; refused from browsers).

Parameters

NameInType
project_idpathstringrequired

Request body

The same fields list GET returns. Each entry can set role, weight, searchable, filterable, facet and sortable.

Responses

  • 200 Starts a background reindex into a new index followed by an atomic alias swap. Search keeps working throughout.
  • 422 Invalid request (error code invalid_request, with details).

Search

Chat

POST /v1/chat

Chat

Conversational search over Server-Sent Events: session, plan, results, clarify?, text*, done.

Auth: Search key or admin key.

Request body

application/json: ChatRequest

Responses

  • 200 Server-Sent Events, in order: session, plan, results, clarify (optional), text (repeated), done. Each data: line is JSON matching the event's schema.
  • 422 Invalid request (error code invalid_request, with details).

Server-Sent Events

Each event's data: line is JSON matching its schema. Order: session, plan, results, clarify (optional), text (repeated), done.

EventData
sessionSessionEvent
planPlanEvent
resultsResultsEvent
clarifyClarifyEvent
textTextEvent
doneDoneEvent

Other

GET /v1/projects/{project_id}/usage

Get Usage

This month's (or period=YYYY-MM) metered requests against the project's limits. search and chat count toward searches_per_month; search-as-you-type requests (llm: false) are typeahead and don't.

Auth: Admin key (server-side only; refused from browsers).

Parameters

NameInType
project_idpathstringrequired
periodquerystring | nulloptional

Responses

  • 200 Successful Response
  • 422 Invalid request (error code invalid_request, with details).

PUT /v1/operator/projects/{project_id}/limits

Put Limits

Replace a project's limits (see findaro.usage). Needs the bootstrap token; an empty body removes all limits.

Auth: Admin key (server-side only; refused from browsers).

Parameters

NameInType
project_idpathstringrequired

Request body

application/json: Limits

Responses

  • 200 Successful Response
  • 422 Invalid request (error code invalid_request, with details).

GET /v1/operator/usage

Operator Usage

Every project with its limits and usage for the month. Needs the bootstrap token.

Auth: Admin key (server-side only; refused from browsers).

Parameters

NameInType
periodquerystring | nulloptional

Responses

  • 200 Successful Response
  • 422 Invalid request (error code invalid_request, with details).

PatchOp

One edit. Examples: {"op": "add_filter", "field": "color", "value": "Black"} {"op": "remove_filter", "field": "color"} (or with "value" to remove one value) {"op": "exclude", "field": "material", "value": "Plastic"} {"op": "set_price_range", "lte": 1500} (no bounds = remove the price range) {"op": "set_sort", "field": "price", "order": "asc"} (no field = back to relevance)
